### Not Verified by This Audit

A clean result above does **not** cover the following. Confirm each one manually before claiming conformance.

| Criterion | Why not automated | How to verify |

| 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) | 9 component(s) colour slotted text through the <slot> element (p-button-pure, p-drilldown-link, p-link-pure, p-text, p-heading). Computed style on the host reports a different colour, so contrast results for this text — including axe-core's — may be wrong in either direction. | Sample this text with a colour picker or the browser contrast inspector. |
| 2.1.1 Keyboard (operability) | tabindex="-1" is a legitimate pattern (roving tabindex, redundant links, programmatic focus targets), so it cannot be treated as a defect. | Operate each control with Enter, Space and arrow keys. |
| 2.4.7 Focus Visible | Focus indicators are commonly painted with ::before/::after or ::part(), which computed styles do not expose. Any automated verdict would be a guess. | Tab through the page and confirm every stop shows a visible indicator. |

## How This Audit Was Conducted
1. Automated axe-core baseline (Phase 1) for each URL in light and in dark (`axe`, `tree`, `coverage`).
2. Domain skill code review (Phases 2–7 and 9). Phase 8 was skipped because no data tables were present.
3. Behavioral Playwright (Phase 10) for keyboard and viewports 320 and 1024, again per URL and color scheme. Axe was not run again.

Compared with `.a11y/runs/2026-10-08-091811/findings.json`.

## Scope and Coverage
| Check | Ran? | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| Code review | yes | Phases 2–7 and 9. Phase 8 skipped (no tables). |
| axe-core runtime | yes | Four scans: `/en/` and `/en/products/`, light and dark. Contrast and ARIA verdicts come from here. Passes were not retained in `raw/`. |
| Behavioural (focus order, traps, reflow, targets, tree) | yes | Keyboard and viewports 320 and 1024, both themes. Tree ran in Phase 1. |
| Authenticated routes | no | These pages are public. |

The product-detail availability banner was not reviewed. Product detail URLs are outside this two-page scope.

The products keyboard pass recorded 100 tab stops, which is the scanner's default cap, so controls after that stop were not traversed. The home page recorded 55 tab stops and no keyboard trap. Closed menus, flyouts, and the search dialog were not opened before measurement, so their internal focus order was not scanned. The keyboard pass does not follow a link and then check where focus lands; route-change focus was reviewed in source.

## Not Verified by This Audit

Included in the generated summary above. Slotted text inside `p-button-pure`, `p-drilldown-link`, `p-link-pure`, `p-text`, and `p-heading` needs a colour-picker check in both themes before those contrast results are treated as settled. Focus-indicator visibility and per-control keyboard operability were not judged. Screen reader announcement of the search status region was not tested with assistive technology.

## Cross-Page Patterns

No scored issue appears on either page. Both pages share the same banner, main navigation (`Main`), main landmark, and contentinfo footer. Page titles are the H1 on both pages (`Iconic Racing Design Taken To Perfection` and `All products`). The products page adds a filter region and a catalog region; the home page adds a trending-products carousel region. Neither page recorded a keyboard trap. The products page reaches the 100-stop keyboard cap; the home page does not.

## What Passed

Both pages have `lang="en"`, a document title, one H1 (`#page-heading`), a skip link, and the primary landmarks. axe-core reported no violations in light or dark. Viewport measurement at 320px and 1024px reported no horizontal overflow and no undersized targets. Newsletter fields in the shared footer use visible labels, `autocomplete` on the name and email fields, and error messages tied through the Porsche Design System field `message` and `state`. Catalog search status text sits in `role="status"` with `aria-atomic="true"`. `RouteFocus` in the locale layout moves focus to `#page-heading` after an in-app route change.

## Recommended Testing Setup

Automated checks cover a minority of WCAG. Keep the Phase 1 and Phase 10 scanner commands in CI for these two URLs, in light and dark, at 320px and 1024px. Add a keyboard test that activates an in-app link and asserts focus is on `#page-heading`. Confirm the search status with VoiceOver (Safari or Chrome) or NVDA and Firefox: open search, type a query, and listen for the status or result count without moving focus. Sample slotted Porsche Design System text with a colour picker in both themes. Tab through each page and confirm a visible focus indicator on every stop, including controls inside shadow DOM.

## Next Steps

Review the Not Verified items before treating this score as release evidence. Optional follow-ups: export CSV, SARIF, or HTML; fix any later findings; add the route-change focus assertion to automated tests.

## Known Limitations

Shadow DOM is traversed, but component-internal state (open menus, focus inside closed overlays, the search dialog) is only checked where it is reachable by Tab from the initial page. The products keyboard traversal stopped at 100 stops. Slotted-text contrast, focus-indicator visibility, and individual control operability are listed under Not Verified. This report does not claim WCAG conformance.
